flags.text: A three-month average of 4,064 head on 2,048 ha of pasture (2.0 head/ha). Amazon pasture rarely supports more than 1.5 head/ha, so the extra animals are likely kept on uncleared or protected land.
flags.title: Herd averaged 132% of pasture capacity for a quarter

flags.text: Following every GTA upstream (mass-balance tracing), 29% of the animals this ranch received originate on ranches with post-2020 clearing, embargoes, Indigenous-land overlap or impossible births.
flags.title: 29% of supply traces to flagged ranches
